mapper.select: SELECT q.* FROM studyroom_questions q JOIN studyroom_runs r ON r.id=q.run_id JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=q.room_id AND s.current_run_id=q.run_id JOIN study_outline_drafts d ON d.id=r.draft_id WHERE q.id=#{questionId} AND q.room_id=#{roomId} AND q.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.*,r.draft_id FROM studyroom_fragments f JOIN studyroom_runs r ON r.id=f.run_id JOIN study_rooms s ON s.current_run_id=r.id JOIN study_outline_drafts d ON d.id=r.draft_id WHERE f.id=#{fragmentId} AND f.run_id=#{runId} AND s.id=#{roomId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT q.id FROM studyroom_questions q JOIN studyroom_generation_jobs j ON j.id=q.job_id WHERE q.user_id=#{userId} AND q.run_id=#{runId} AND q.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND j.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET priority=#{priority} WHERE id=#{jobId}
UPDATE studyroom_questions SET job_id=#{jobId} WHERE id=#{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT q.id FROM studyroom_questions q JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=q.room_id AND s.current_run_id=q.run_id WHERE q.user_id=#{userId} AND q.room_id=#{roomId} AND q.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.id,q.user_id,q.room_id FROM studyroom_questions q JOIN studyroom_generation_jobs j ON j.id=q.job_id JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=q.room_id AND s.current_run_id=q.run_id WHERE q.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND j.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED') AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT status,failure_code,failure_message FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='CANCELLED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
